column1: # Expected file counts per kind for a built fixture folder, from the spec's Fixtures section, written by hand.
# Columns: folder (the folder's own name, under the fixture root), kind, count. kit-fixtures.sh expect counts <folder> compares
# the files on disk with the rows of that folder: every row must match and no other kind may be present. A folder with no row is
# only printed. Counts are by extension, every file under the folder (hidden folders, Caches, .git and the like included, the
# file-gate rules not applied: those are what the product decides and the gate matrix checks); a file of an unsupported
# extension is not a kind and is not counted (spec Goals: "not read, not counted, not listed").
# The tree rows follow scripts/kit-lib/tree.tsv; a folder's row is the total of the group of that name.
# The home folders, the mini mix and the extra folder (plan 2): the rows follow scripts/kit-lib/home.tsv. Documents holds Work.
# The overlap fixture of S1.6 (plan 2, fix round C): the rows of scripts/kit-lib/overlap.tsv, six photos under photos/ and two loose.
# The 500-file mix of the spec (Fixtures, S6.11; plan 5): 220 photos, 120 documents, 100 PDFs, 40 audio files, 20 video files, no code.
# The golden repos (job 2, plan 7, t1): every document and picture under the folder by extension, .git and the excluded files included
# (the rules are what the product decides). Code files are never read and are not a kind: they are not counted. api-client: 3 documents
# (retry-notes.md, .env.local.md, id_rsa.txt) and the retry diagram; the .pem, .key, .p12, .pfx and .kdbx are not a kind. legacy-sync: its
# diagram. scratch-lab holds code files only, so it has no row.
